cues: e-commerce is buying and selling, and moving the money, over electronic networks.
Its models are named by who sits at each end.
Business to business: a wholesaler supplying shops.
Business to consumer: an online shop like Daraz.
Consumer to consumer: selling your old bicycle on Hamrobazar.
Consumer to business: a freelancer selling photos to a company.
In Nepal the money moves through wallets and QR payments, under the Electronic Transactions Act of twenty sixty three.
